a: K.E.V.I.N stands for Keeping Every Voice in Need. It is a free chat companion that listens patiently and responds with warmth and without judgment. It is an AI, not a person or a therapist.

K.E.V.I.N runs on your own device, so your messages are not sent to a server. The first visit downloads the model files from Hugging Face. Saved conversations stay in your browser's storage, and you can turn saving off or delete everything in Settings.

q: Do I need an account or an API key?
a: No. There is no sign-up, no account and no API key.

q: What do I need to use it?
a: A recent browser such as Chrome, Edge or Safari. If your browser supports WebGPU, replies are faster; otherwise K.E.V.I.N runs on your CPU, which is slower. The first start downloads a few hundred MB, and after that it loads from your browser's cache.

q: Can K.E.V.I.N replace therapy or emergency help?
a: No. K.E.V.I.N is not a therapist, doctor or emergency service. If you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, contact your local emergency number or a crisis line right away.

q: Which AI model does it use?
a: It uses SmolLM2-360M-Instruct from Hugging Face, a small model that fits in a browser. Small models can give simple answers and sometimes get things wrong.
